facts: short wide CLEAR GLASS jar with a threaded glass neck, glass visible above and below the label
brushed SILVER metal screw lid with a finely ridged (knurled) side edge, plain flat top
turquoise (teal) paper label wraps the middle of the jar
label front: white rectangle with turquoise text TOOTHPASTE TABLETS; NOVA over TABZ in big white serif capitals; PEPPERMINT in spaced white capitals below
label left: 62 / TABLETS in white; label right: NET WT / 23G / (0.8 OZ) in white; tiny white text on the side panels
tablets are plain WHITE, round, flat with rounded edges, about the size of an aspirin, no print, no colour, no stripes
jar is 2.17 x 2.17 x 1.65 inches: fits in a palm, smaller than a coffee mug
box: white cube, turquoise NOVA TABZ circle on top, turquoise print
